description_en: Executes evaluation rules to perform compliance pre-checks on resources
description_zh: 执行预检规则对资源进行合规预检
kebab_example: aliyun config evaluate-pre-config-rules --resource-type-format ros --resource-evaluate-items '[{"ResourceLogicalId":"ResourceLogicId-test","ResourceType":"ACS::ECS::Instance","ResourceProperties":"{\"ResourceGroupId\":\"\",\"Memory\":8192,\"InstanceChargeType\":\"PostPaid\",\"Cpu\":2}","Rules":[{"Identifier":"ecs-instance-deletion-protection-enabled","InputParameters":"{}"}]}]' --enable-managed-rules false --api-version 2020-09-07 --region cn-hangzhou
name: EvaluatePreConfigRules

element_fields.help_en:
The logical ID of the resource.

If this parameter is empty, it is generated based on the Base64 value of `ResourceProperties`
element_fields.help_zh:
资源逻辑ID。

如果该参数为空，则按照`ResourceProperties`的Base64位生成
element_fields.name: resource_logical_id

element_fields.help_en:
The type of the resource.

For information about how to obtain the identifier of an evaluation rule, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/467810.html.

The `ResourceType`, `Identifier`, and `ResourceProperties` parameters must be specified at the same time
element_fields.help_zh:
资源类型。

关于如何获取预检规则的标识，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/467810.html。

参数`ResourceType`、`Identifier`和`ResourceProperties`必须同时设置
element_fields.name: resource_type

element_fields.help_en:
The identifier of the rule.

For information about how to obtain the identifier of a rule, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/467810.html.

The `ResourceType`, `Identifier`, and `ResourceProperties` parameters must be specified at the same time
element_fields.help_zh:
规则标识。

关于如何获取规则标识，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/467810.html。

参数`ResourceType`、`Identifier`和`ResourceProperties`必须同时设置
element_fields.name: identifier

element_fields.help_en: The input parameters of the rule
element_fields.name: input_parameters

element_fields.help_en: An array that contains the evaluation rules
element_fields.name: rules

element_fields.help_en:
The resource configuration items (properties of the resource to be created), such as the specifications, region, name, status, and port or network interface switch status of the resource.

The `ResourceType`, `Identifier`, and `ResourceProperties` parameters must be specified at the same time
element_fields.help_zh:
资源配置项（即将创建的资源属性），例如：资源的规格、所属地域、名称、状态、端口或网口开关状态等。

参数`ResourceType`、`Identifier`和`ResourceProperties`必须同时设置
element_fields.name: resource_properties

parameters.help_en: An array that contains the resources that you want to evaluate
parameters.name: resource_evaluate_items

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable rule templates. Valid values:

true: enables rule templates.

false (default): does not enable rule templates
parameters.help_zh:
是否启用规则模板。取值：

true：启用规则模板。

false（默认值）：不启用规则模板
parameters.name: enable_managed_rules
